brief:
Israeli occupation forces carried out strikes in multiple locations across the Gaza Strip on Saturday, according to Shehab Wire. Artillery bombardment and gunfire targeted several sites throughout the territory, with at least one civilian injured in the strike. A woman in al-Nuseirat refugee camp sustained injuries in the attacks, the agency's correspondent reported from the scene.

The strikes marked the latest in a series of military operations across Gaza. Shehab Wire's correspondent confirmed additional casualties beyond the initial reports, though a full accounting of those affected remained unclear as operations continued throughout the day.
